LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_ChargeSpikeDesc: Drive a hemalurgic spike through the subject to capture a fragment of their spirit web. The metal of the spike determines what is stolen.
LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_ImplantSpikeDesc: Surgically implant a charged hemalurgic spike into the subject, transferring the stolen attribute. Each spike weakens the recipient's spirit web, opening them to the Shard that made it.
LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_RemoveSpikeDesc: Extract an implanted hemalurgic spike. The process is dangerous and the recipient will lose the stolen attribute.
LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_ChargeSuccess: {SURGEON} drove a {METAL} spike through {DONOR}, stealing a fragment of their spirit web.
LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_ChargeFailed: {SURGEON} failed to properly charge the spike. The spike is ruined.
LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_DonorDied: {DONOR} did not survive the hemalurgic procedure.
LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_NothingToSteal: The spike found nothing to steal from {DONOR}.
LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_NoUnchargedSpike: Requires an uncharged hemalurgic spike or needle.
LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_NoChargedSpike: Requires a charged hemalurgic spike or needle.
LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_CannotImplantAluminum: An aluminum spike carries only destruction. It cannot be implanted.
LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_ImplantSuccess: {SURGEON} implanted a charged {METAL} spike into {RECIPIENT}. The stolen power takes hold.
LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_SnappedByConnection: The spike's Connection floods through {PAWN}'s spirit web, cracking it open.
LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_CorpseTooOld: The spiritual residue has already faded from this corpse. There is nothing left to steal.
LanguageData.CS_Hemalurgy_CorpseAlreadySpiked: This corpse has already been stripped of its spiritual essence.
